cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'm ready for our audition results. Why are you breathing like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. Four in, six out. I like to arrive already regulated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Lend me your pen; my support network deserves advance notice.

mechanism: A claims mastery while approving and adopting B's coping techniques as A's own arrangements.
confusable: Unlike asking openly for reassurance, A maintains emotional readiness and converts help into authorized procedure.
comparison: Audition peers sharing breathing and call plans differ from one person reading a rejection email for another.
seedUse: Use the audition breathing and support-list seed; use S01 to make B's suggestions require A's permission as A borrows them.
